title: Acquirer: eBet Ltd; Target: Turbo Bonus

body_sections.Summary: Acquisition of Turbo Bonus by eBet Limited
body_sections.Market definition: State based markets for in-venue gaming and promotional management systems
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 4 November 2002 the Commission considered that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant market for the following reasons: the availability of alternative products; the demonstrated ability of smaller competitors in the market to outbid or win customers from larger competitors; the scope for international firms to penetrate the market; and the degree of countervailing power possessed by purchasers of in-venue gaming and promotional management services.
